plan: Plan 8/8: Benchmark Return Gate And Comparison Rerun Packet

gates.summary: Natural prompts produce bounded TaskSpec intake or visible clarification/block states before coder execution.
Generic model-authored Read/List/Search/Write/Edit/MultiEdit/RunCheck/AskClarification/ReturnFinal actions parse with stable error codes and no backend-authored content.
Disposable workspace execution is path-contained, records raw transcript/actions/diffs/checks/receipts, and blocks unsafe authority.
Mac worker and subagents are advisory-only and cannot write, apply, start hidden workers, mutate Cartographer, change providers, or read secrets.

/coding exposes TaskSpec, tool truth, action transcript, diff/check output, safe-apply blocked status, and copy diagnostics. Live browser smoke remained blocked by existing dev-server state, but automated UI/runtime tests passed.
Golden tasks, protected/wrong-file/hidden-worker/Mac-write/malformed/diff-format/Cart/fake-apply traps, hidden mutation scoring, and receipt completeness checks are verified.

no_hidden_mutation_proof.method: Plan 7 scoring compares receipt before/after workspace file sets against reported files_touched and fails hidden mutation.

stress_testing_decision.meaning: Native hands return gate is ready for manual review and a separately approved comparison/stress plan. No stress test or benchmark was run in Plan 8.
